name: C078 Kẻ Cắp Khiên Cổ Đại (Trượng Đoạt Thuẫn Hóa Linh)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a Mythic SSR dark-fantasy Ancient Shield-Thief's aegis-siphon claw staff (Trượng Đoạt Thuẫn Hóa Linh - C078 Kẻ Cắp Khiên Cổ Đại) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete mythic siphon staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (ornate obsidian-and-gold runic shaft) to top-right (a dragon-talon magnetic grapple claw crushing and absorbing a captured glowing cyan-gold hexagonal energy shield prism).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom spike to top claw-and-shield-prism head with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use royal gold, blackened obsidian, platinum runes, and brilliant cyan-blue & gold barrier fragments).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Ancient Shield-Thief Siphon Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal dragon-claw shield-siphon staff at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame mythic shield-steal vortex: glowing cyan-gold hexagonal barrier shards and mana lightning spiraling into the golden claw core.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Ancient Shield-Thief Siphon Staff (Trượng Đoạt Thuẫn Hóa Linh - C078 Kẻ Cắp Khiên Cổ Đại) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the mythic golden claw shield-siphon staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): an ancient coliseum battlefield where shattered cyan-gold barrier shields are ripped from the shadows and drawn into the staff's glowing core.
